snippet.title: Crowns and Pawns: Amber Road | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
It's time for a new journey across Europe! We're happy to announce the second game in the series, Crowns and Pawns: Amber Road!

Follow the legendary Amber Road across Europe in this thrilling point-and-click road adventure. Will you have the wits to uncover the mystery behind the enigmatic artifact - the Sun stone?

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4708130
Join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/P5qRm2b2UT
Official website: https://crownsandpawns.com/
